name: ASSA tag check
description: Finds and fixes broken ASSA override tags (unclosed braces, missing parentheses, HTML colors, unknown or mistyped tags), warns about undefined styles, duplicate \pos/\an, too long fades and missing fonts, and tidies tags that do nothing - like , {\i0}{\i1} or a color set twice. Checkable before/after preview.
